breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly specified both Dirichlet and Periodic boundary conditions, which are mutually exclusive. The ground truth removed the periodic condition. The agent correctly identified this conflict and generated a specification that only includes the Dirichlet boundary conditions: u(0,t)=1 and u(1,t)=-1, completely omitting the contradictory periodic instruction.
